llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究硅添加对7075铝合金SLM工艺的影响，与生物医用植入物的应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on aluminum alloy processability for aerospace applications, with no biomedical context, no porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, and no fatigue testing relevant to implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究硅添加对7075铝合金SLM成形性的影响
summary_zh.method: 制备不同硅含量的铝合金粉末并进行SLM打印，表征微观结构和力学性能
summary_zh.result: 硅添加改善了SLM成形性，细化了晶粒，提高了强度
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EBSD和拉伸测试验证微观结构和力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of silicon addition on the selective laser melting processability of 7075 aluminum alloy.
summary_en.method: Aluminum alloy powders with varying silicon content were prepared and processed by SLM, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Silicon addition improved SLM processability, refined grain structure, and enhanced mechanical strength.
summary_en.validation: Microstructure was validated by SEM and EBSD, and mechanical properties by tensile testing.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not report surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计兼具高强度与高韧性的多孔钛合金支架用于承重骨科。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备功能梯度多孔Ti6Al4V支架，并进行力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 功能梯度设计显著提高了支架的强度和韧性。
summary_zh.validation: 准静态压缩和疲劳测试验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To design porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds with both high strength and toughness for load-bearing orthopedic applications.
summary_en.method: Functionally graded porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds were fabricated via selective laser melting and mechanically tested.
summary_en.result: The functionally graded design significantly enhanced both strength and toughness of the scaffolds.
summary_en.validation: Quasi-static compression and fatigue tests were conducted to validate mechanical performance.

papers.title: A laminin‐211‐derived bioactive peptide promotes the osseointegration of a sandblasted, large‐grit, acid‐etched titanium implant
papers.abstract: Early implant loading is very important for reducing the duration of missing teeth in human patients. The laminin-derived peptide, DLTIDDSYWYRI motif (Ln2-P3), accelerates bone healing. Therefore, to investigate the hypothesis that Ln2-P3 increases the bone response to sandblasted, large-grit, acid-etched (SLA) titanium implants, the effect of the Ln2-P3 peptide on the osseointegration of SLA titanium implants was evaluated in vitro and in vivo. Human osteoblast-like cells were cultured on untreated, scrambled peptide (SP)-treated, and Ln2-P3-treated SLA titanium discs, and the cellular responses of these cells were evaluated. The Ln2-P3 treatment augmented osteoblast attachment and spreading, alkaline phosphatase activity, and the expression of osteogenic marker genes. Furthermore, the untreated and Ln2-P3-treated SLA titanium implants were inserted into the tibiae of rabbits for 9 and 11 days. Compared with the untreated implants, the Ln2-P3-treated implants showed a significantly higher bone-to-implant contact ratio at Day 9 after implantation and an increased bone area. The Ln2-P3 treatment of the SLA titanium implant surface augmented osteoblastic activity and accelerated peri-implant bone formation at the bone-implant interface. Overall, these results indicated that compared with the SLA titanium surface alone, the Ln2-P3 peptide-treated SLA titanium surface enhances initial osseointegration, thereby facilitating earlier implant loading.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究钛种植体表面肽修饰促进骨整合，但未涉及股骨柄假体、应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or contact mechanics in hip implants; it focuses on surface bioactivity for dental or small animal implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 早期加载对减少缺牙时间很重要，需加速骨整合。
summary_zh.method: 在SLA钛表面修饰Ln2-P3肽，体外培养成骨细胞并植入兔胫骨。
summary_zh.result: 肽处理增强了成骨细胞活性，提高了骨-种植体接触率和骨面积。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和兔体内植入实验。

summary_en.motivation: Early implant loading is critical for reducing treatment duration, motivating the need for accelerated osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Ln2-P3 peptide was immobilized on sandblasted, large-grit, acid-etched (SLA) titanium surfaces; in vitro osteoblast assays and in vivo rabbit tibia implantation were performed.
summary_en.result: Peptide treatment enhanced osteoblast attachment, spreading, alkaline phosphatase activity, and osteogenic gene expression, and significantly increased bone-to-implant contact and bone area at 9 days post-implantation.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture on titanium discs and in vivo rabbit tibia model with histomorphometric analysis.

papers.title: PKM Blended Learning dengan Google Classroom for Education bagi Guru SMA Sederajat di Kecamatan Tambusai Provinsi Riau
papers.abstract: In accordance with its development, especially in the era of disruption 4.0 that future teachers should be able to present the appropriate module that meets passion of students, in the era of the development of emerging technology, the modules used in the study are not always use the conventional modules such as paper-based modules. Rather, the future teacher must be able to present course material in the form of modules that can be accessed online by students. Teachers must be able to present the joyful and innovative learning, i.e. learning that blends hands on and mind on, problem-based leraning and project based learning The goal is to create an active learning, creative and fun. Google Classroom for Education is one of the features of the free Google product that can be used as a medium of blended learning. With a variety of features it has, Google Classroom can be used to demonstrate or visualize concept of lessons with no face to face needed. Community Partnership program is one of the mentoring, coaching, and training activities to high school teachers in Tambusai in Rokan Hulu, Riau. The results of this activity is expected to build teachers who are capable of designing learning program by utilizing Google Classroom for Education as a medium of learning that is blended and occurs in digital paperless classroom. Keywords: blended learning, Google Classroom, paperless  Abstrak  Sesuai dengan perkembangannya terutama pada era disrupsi 4.0 yaitu guru masa depan harus mampu menyajikan modul sesuai minat siswa, di era perkembangan teknologi yang semakin berkembang, modul yang digunakan dalam pembelajaran tidak selalu menggunakan modul konvensional seperti modul berbasis paper. Melainkan guru masa depan pun harus mampu menyajikan materi pelajaran dalam bentuk modul yang bisa diakses secara daring oleh para siswa. Guru masa depan harus mampu menyajikan pembelajaran yang menyenangkan dan inovatif, yakni pembelajaran yang memadukan hands on and mind on, problem based learning dan project based learning. Tujuannya adalah untuk menciptakan pembelajaran yang aktif, kreatif dan menyenangkan. Google Classroom for Education merupakan salah satu fitur dari produk Google yang dapat dimanfaatkan sebagai media blended learning. Dengan berbagai fitur yang dimilikinya, Google Classroom dapat digunakan untuk mendemontrasikan atau memvisualisasikan konsep-konsep pelajaran secara online tanpa mesti tatap muka. Kegiatan Pengabdian Kemitraan Masyarakat ini merupakan salah satu kegiatan pendampingan, pembimbingan, dan pelatihan kepada Guru SMA di Kecamatan Tambusai di kabupaten Rokan Hulu, Riau. Hasil dari kegiatan pengabdian ini diharapkan dapat melahirkan guru yang mampu merancang pembelajaran dengan memanfaatkan Google Classroom for Education sebagai media pembelajaran blended learning dalam kelas digital tanpa kertas (paperless). Kata kunci: pembelajaran campuran, Google Classroom, pembelajaran tanpa kertas
